verdicts.reason: A3 fails: the brief's Analyze names the entry file, the broken invariant, the files not to touch, and a log line, but the done-when only checks the quoted log line and entry file, with no invariant and no do-not-touch list.
A3 fails: the brief requires the actual output recorded next to the expected, but the done-when checks only a non-zero exit of the pinned smallest command and never compares actual with expected.

A3 fails: the done-when only compares the set of changed files to the plan; it does not check that the public signature stays stable or that each non-obvious hunk has a one-line note, both of which the brief names.

A5 fails: checkRunnable is true, but the check depends on a per-project verify_gate.sh (with a render-compare step) that no registered tool supplies and that is not shown to exist; A3 also fails because the done-when names no specific test and does not enforce the Stop hook block, and A4 fails because "gate absent" appears only in the trigger, not as a valid done-when result.

All rules hold: the done-when has a tool enumerate files (git ls-files filtered to one shape), requires a recheck of N/N files on isolated copies, rejects unrechecked files, and accepts N=0; status assisted matches the brief, and checkRunnable false is honest because the codemod and recheck runner is absent.

All rules hold: each comment must carry file:line with a verbatim quote that a program can match against git diff, unquoted comments are dropped, zero findings is a valid result, status assisted matches the brief, and checkRunnable false claims no unwritten program.

A3 fails: the brief requires tracing one request from entry to store and naming the module that owns each hop, but the done-when only checks one hop's log-line match and enforces neither the full entry-to-store trace nor a module per hop.
